comparison: Same three source fixtures and 34 coverage criteria as v1/v2. Core now sees the coverage checklist. No previous answer tree or final Codex content review is fed to Qwen. A single development-set trial, no causal or stability claim.
holdouts: Copied unchanged, never included in prompts; not a model examination score.
atomicity: Separate independently diagnosable rules. Conditions stay with their rule; combined application questions do not replace atoms.
structural_acceptance: Each original point is a separate revision transaction
Old revisions and replacement map preserved
Dependent checks and edges are invalidated, not blindly copied to all children
Stale hashes and scope escapes rejected
Incomplete teaching remains a visible pending item
answer_acceptance: Model predicted stdout is never a verified answer
Exact code plus environment receipt required
Run finite defined eligible snippets at O0 and O2
A/B symptom predictions equal and incorrect
Numeric contract does not prove hypothesis semantics
execution_eligibility: Codex inspects each runtime snippet before exact-hash allowlisting; this is a restricted local experiment, not an automatic general C sandbox.
repair_scope: Failed checks and checks linked to misconceptions, all misconception candidates and all relation candidates. Core is frozen. No additions/deletions; replacements only. Compiler and machine-contract feedback only, no Codex semantic corrections fed to model.
final_assessment: Codex separately reviews every point, coverage unit, relation and misconception; nonblind, not teacher gold standard. Counts of candidates, structural successes, numeric checks, and semantic approvals reported separately.
data_boundary: No live course writes, no production model configuration changes, no handout generation or rewriting.
